method: Official public documentation; no paid API calls, fresh latency measurements or quality benchmarks. Existing feature flags describe anysearch SDK mappings; native API overview is separate.

deepseek.pricing: $0.75 / 1K successful nonempty Search requests; Fetch separately $0.75 / 1K
deepseek.free: No recurring direct API allowance verified; server-side tool promotion is separate
deepseek.limits: Search 100 QPS/account; Fetch 25 QPS/account; Fetch also per-domain throttled
deepseek.overview: Raw JSON POST /v1/tools/search; 1–50 results, optional content, summaries; site/lang/date query operators. Separate Markdown Fetch API.
deepseek.name: DeepSeek
deepseek.caveat: Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

exa.pricing: Lite $4; Auto $7; Deep $12 / 1K requests (≤10 results); extra results $1 / 1K each
exa.limits: Free 10 QPS; PAYG up to 25 QPS
exa.overview: Exa 3.0 released October 19; Lite and Auto; Dynamic Highlights GA. Contents $1 / 1K pages per content type; summaries separately priced.

primary_price.basis: ≤10 results; Auto/Deep and content add-ons differ

brave.pricing: Search $5 / 1K requests; Answers $4 / 1K + $5/M input and output tokens
brave.overview: Web, news, images, videos and LLM context; Answers is a separate generated-answer product.

tavily.pricing: PAYG $8 / 1K basic; $16 / 1K advanced (1/2 credits); subscriptions differ
tavily.overview: Search, extract, crawl and research are separate credit rules; do not price research as basic search.

primary_price.basis: Advanced uses two credits; subscription commitments differ

firecrawl.pricing: 2 credits / 10 search results; scraping add-ons separate; Hobby $19/month for 5K credits
firecrawl.overview: Search with optional page scraping; annual Hobby $16/month billed annually differs from monthly plan.

primary_price.basis: Credit-based; no flat cash rate ranked

perplexity.pricing: Fast $1; Standard $5 / 1K requests (up to 5 queries/request); no raw Search model tokens
perplexity.free: No general free API allowance verified
perplexity.limits: 1–20 results; other account limits per docs
perplexity.overview: Ranked Search results and extracted text; Sonar, Agent and Research are separate model-mediated products. Empty HTTP-200 responses are billable.

primary_price.basis: Standard $5; up to five queries per request

you.pricing: Search $5 / 1K calls; live extraction +$1 / 1K pages; cached extraction no surcharge
you.free: $10 signup advertised on canonical pricing; keyless MCP 100 searches/day
you.limits: Up to 100 results; PAYG no minimum
you.overview: Web and news search; Research has separate pricing. Legacy marketing says $100 signup; current canonical page says $10.

linkup.pricing: Flash/Fast/Standard raw $5; sourced/structured $6; Deep raw $50 or synthesized $55 / 1K
linkup.free: Eligible professional-email accounts topped back up to $20 monthly
linkup.overview: Raw searchResults, sourcedAnswer and structured output use distinct prices; errors/empty no-relevant-result calls not billed.

parallel.free: Up to $80 signup; eligible card-backed organizations $5 monthly credit
parallel.limits: Extract $1 / 1K URLs; account limits per plan
parallel.overview: Search and Extract differ from Task processors. Spending limits are notification-only, not hard blocks.

jina.pricing: Token-priced: ≥10K tokens/request; $50/1B tokens implies ≥$0.50 / 1K, not flat CPM
jina.free: 10M free tokens listed with noncommercial CC-BY-NC condition; recurrence unverified
jina.overview: s.jina.ai requires key; r.jina.ai URL reader uses separate output-token billing.

primary_price.basis: Token-priced; lower-bound request estimate is not a flat price

serper.limits: Starter 50 QPS; larger tiers 100/200/300 QPS; credits expire after 6 months
serper.overview: Third-party Google SERP service; successful responses billed; tax excluded. Lowest rate requires $3,750 prepaid.

serpapi.overview: Third-party SERP access to multiple engines; not official Google/Bing developer API.

searchapi.limits: Entry plan $40/month; enhanced speed may differ
searchapi.overview: Third-party SERP service; only HTTP-200 success billed; $100/35K equals ~$2.86 / 1K.

google_pse.pricing: Existing users: $5 / 1K above free quota; up to 10K/day
google_pse.limits: Closed to new customers; transition by January 1, 2027
google_pse.overview: Configured Programmable Search Engine + key required; Vertex AI domain search is not unrestricted web search.
google_pse.status: Closed to new customers; discontinued January 1, 2027

primary_price.basis: Closed to new customers; not ranked as currently available

gemini.pricing: Gemini 3+: $14 / 1K individual search queries + model charges
gemini.limits: One prompt may generate several billable queries; older model rules differ
gemini.overview: Google Search grounding inside Gemini generation, not standalone raw ranked search.

primary_price.basis: Model tokens extra; older model rules differ

dataforseo.pricing: Standard queue $0.60; Priority $1.20; Live $2 / 1K SERP pages (≤10 organic results/page)
dataforseo.limits: $50 minimum prepaid; no subscription/expiry; Standard average ~5min, target 45min
dataforseo.overview: Depth, operators and extras alter cost; queued jobs are not comparable to Live latency.
dataforseo.name: DataForSEO

primary_price.basis: ≤10 results/page; queued, not Live; $50 prepaid minimum

brightdata.pricing: PAYG $1.50 / 1K successful requests; Scale $499/month includes 380K then $1.30 / 1K
brightdata.overview: SERP proxy; requests are not individual organic links; async collection not another billed request.
brightdata.name: Bright Data

openai.pricing: web_search $10 / 1K tool calls + search-content tokens at model rates
openai.limits: Legacy preview rules differ; model availability and limits vary
openai.overview: Model-hosted web_search; tool cost is not total answer cost or raw search price.
openai.name: OpenAI Web Search

anthropic.limits: Model/tool limits vary; tool use requires compatible model
anthropic.overview: Claude server-side web search tool; not standalone raw search. Generated answers and search-result processing add model costs.
anthropic.name: Anthropic Web Search

xai.pricing: Web Search $5 / 1K tool calls + model tokens
xai.limits: X Search billed separately: posts/profiles use different units
xai.overview: Model-hosted web_search; X Search is distinct and is not public web search.
xai.name: xAI Web Search

primary_price.basis: Model tokens extra; X Search separate

bing_legacy.pricing: Retired; current direct API pricing not applicable
bing_legacy.overview: Azure Grounding with Bing is a separate hosted service; Bing via SerpApi is a third-party wrapper.
bing_legacy.name: Bing Search (retired)

kagi.free: No free Search API quota stated
kagi.limits: Usage invoiced every 30 days or at $100; Extract up to 10 URLs/request
kagi.overview: Current GET /api/v1/search uses Authorization: Bot; web/images/news/videos/podcasts, lenses and locale controls. v0 is legacy; existing anysearch adapter uses v0.

duckduckgo.pricing: No library API fee; hosting/proxy/upstream costs separate
duckduckgo.free: No contracted quota or SLA established
duckduckgo.limits: Upstream throttling; library/version and deployment dependent
duckduckgo.overview: Unofficial DDGS/Dux Distributed Global Search metasearch library; no verified DuckDuckGo affiliation or unlimited commercial service.

searxng.free: No hosted free allowance; self-hosted instance limits apply
searxng.limits: JSON/CSV/RSS must be enabled; public instances may return 403
searxng.overview: GET/POST / or /search; language/time/safe-search and query operators depend on upstream engines.

keiro.pricing: Conflicting official pricing: Keiro lite from $0.10 / 1K; browserfoundry $0.25 / 1K
keiro.free: Conflict: Keiro 750 credits/month; browserfoundry 1,250; free/paid conversion differs
keiro.limits: Conflict: 15 vs 30 RPM; paid starts $29.99 vs $30
keiro.overview: Rebranded browserfoundry; claims existing keys/endpoints continue. Fast proxy-backed search; Content, Answer and Agentic are separate. Do not assume paid credit conversion for free tier.

octen.pricing: Promotional Web Search $1 / 1K (normally $5), includes 10 full-content results; +$0.50 / 1K extra results
octen.limits: $5 minimum top-up; 10 QPS free, up to 20 after top-up; QPS subscription excludes usage
octen.overview: Search 1–100 results; domain/language/date/safe-search, content/highlights. Broad mode bills per generated subquery. 62ms p50 is a vendor claim, not a guarantee.

primary_price.basis: Normally $5; ten full-content results included; expansion extra
